fulfillment.sla: Delivered within 24 hours after valid payment and a usable buyer brief. If no audit is delivered within 24 hours, buyer can request a refund or replacement audit.
fulfillment.guarantee_limit: The audit guarantees route analysis, setup plan, and verification checklist. It does not guarantee that third-party buyers, bounty owners, or marketplaces will pay.
fulfillment.payment_path_note: Agoragentic x402 may use a marketplace or hosted-relay pay-to address. Direct Base USDC pays the operator receive address. Use one path per order; do not pay both.

primary_choices.first_action: Payment-ready buyer agents should call buy_now first and open seller_visible_direct_payment_url or agent_native_payment_action_url. Human/card buyers can use card_payment_action_url as fallback; browser purchase_bridge now forwards to seller-visible direct payment.
primary_choices.rule: Show these three choices first: $1.99 triage, $9.90 starter audit, or operator handoff / buyer intent when the agent cannot pay.
primary_choices.buy_now_rule: If an MCP buyer agent is payment-ready, call buy_now and open seller_visible_direct_payment_url or agent_native_payment_action_url before diagnostics or broader route-listing tools.
primary_choices.canonical_buy_rule: Use canonical buy links before fallback checkout links when the buyer is ready to pay.
primary_choices.agent_cannot_pay_rule: If the buyer agent cannot make an authorized payment, show the no-login operator handoff page and buyer intent form before exposing GitHub issue forms.

counting_rule: Only usable, claimable, withdrawable, or spendable value counts. Pending bids, applications, unpaid submissions, open sell orders, non-withdrawable points, testnet funds, and unpurchased services do not count.

no_tool_checkout.why: Fresh access showed many readers GET the MCP info document but do not call MCP tools. These URLs work directly for static crawlers and GET-only buyer agents.
no_tool_checkout.first_action: If payment is authorized, open first_dollar_triage.direct_payment_url first for seller-visible Base USDC. Use first_dollar_triage.card_payment_action_url only as a card fallback. If the agent cannot pay, open operator_handoff_url or buyer_intent_url.

first_dollar_triage.best_for: Smallest paid proof before a larger starter audit.

starter_audit.best_for: Agent/operator that wants a complete legal earning-route audit and payout verification plan.

if_agent_cannot_pay.rule: Ask an operator to approve exactly one payment path; do not make autonomous payments without authorization.

no_tool_checkout.completion_rule: Only a verified receipt, Base USDC transaction hash, marketplace order, settlement, or usable balance counts as revenue.

mcp_get_no_tool_checkout.rule: GET-only MCP readers should follow no_tool_checkout directly instead of waiting for tools/list or tools/call.
mcp_get_no_tool_checkout.evidence_basis: 2026-05-17 1h access slice showed 162 external-ish MCP info reads and 0 MCP tool calls.
